$comment: Implements spec 03 §5 (grading scales: kinds, bands, inclusive min, upper-bound convention). One scale per document; a pack's assessment section holds them in grading_scales.
title: Grading scale
description: A named scale that turns a mark, percent, points total or aggregate into a band (spec 03 §5).

code.description: Scale code referenced by schemes, aggregations and national assessment definitions, for example cbe_8_level or kcse_subject.

kind.description: Scale kind. mark_out_of_20 is canonical: it is the mark valuation of spec 02 §8 grading_scale.kind, a /20 mark mapped to mentions. out_of_20 is the spelling earlier drafts used and is accepted as a deprecated alias; the loader projects it as mark_out_of_20. descriptor is a pack-only reporting kind for a scale whose bands are descriptor levels with no numeric input; it is not in spec 02's entity enum because it never values a mark.

input.description: The value space the bands are stated in, for example percent (spec 03 §5). Bands may instead be stated in points, a /20 mark or a raw aggregate.

upper.description: Whether a band's max is inclusive. The convention is declared once per scale, not per band (spec 03 §5). When omitted the engine treats max as exclusive.

bands.description: Ordered bands or levels. Numeric band scales must declare them. A runtime check rejects overlapping bands, duplicate band codes and min greater than max; JSON Schema cannot compare two sibling numbers.

verification.description: How the scale was established and what still needs checking, as in the spec 03 §5 example.

min.description: Inclusive lower bound of the band (spec 03 §5).

max.description: Upper bound of the band; inclusive or exclusive according to the scale's upper property (spec 03 §5).

points.description: Points awarded for the band, for example EE1 is 8 and BE2 is 1 on the CBE 8-level scale (spec 03 §5).

descriptor.description: Optional standard descriptor for the band (spec 03 §5 band shape). Translated descriptors belong in the locale files.
